name: Hibikino Yukari
source:
School Year: Gap Year Before University
Occupation: Hibikino Shop Manager (Marketing, Product Procurement)

"I'm the manager of an eroge shop, you know? Reading eroge during work is just another part of my duties!"

The oldest of the Hibikino sisters, she's the eroge-loving obsessive who had their family home renovated into an eroge shop.
In contrast to her young appearance, she spews out dirty jokes like you wouldn't imagine.

She loves talking about the eroge she likes, and channeled that passion into making an eroge shop. But she left all of the annoying stuff to Tsumugi.
Despite being on a gap year after having failed to get into university, she doesn't seem to have any intention of studying.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/hibikino/]official site[/url]]
